name: Dark Eldar Coterie
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.083-086 (Dark Eldar Coterie). Statlines from datasheets pp.084-085; equipment list p.084; special equipment/skills p.086. Eldar have no sourced racial-maximum profile (ceilings left null). Scourge's starting experience was not listed in the p.083 table (8 assumed - TODO verify). specialRules.name: Melee Specialists
specialRules.description: May only use Splinter Pistols and Throwing Weapons as ranged weapons.

heroSlots.notes: Broken by their Maker: must earn twice the usual XP to gain an advance. TODO: verify skill-table access.

specialRules.name: Cause Fear
specialRules.description: Wracks are nightmares made manifest and cause fear.

specialRules.name: Immune to Psychology
specialRules.description: Not affected by psychology; never leaves combat.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treat a 'stunned' result on the Injury chart as 'knocked down'.

specialRules.name: Broken by their Maker
specialRules.description: Must earn twice the usual number of experience points to gain an advance.

heroSlots.notes: May be accompanied by up to two Warp Beasts (brought as henchmen). TODO: verify skill-table access.

Fly: may move 12" in any direction ignoring terrain, no Initiative checks for levels; no diving charges; still needs line of sight to charge. Starting XP not listed in the ruleset table (8 assumed - TODO verify). TODO: verify skill-table access.

specialRules.name: Fly
specialRules.description: May move 12" in any direction ignoring terrain; no Initiative checks moving between building levels; may not make diving charges; still needs line of sight to charge.

henchmenTypes.notes: The beating heart of the warband. Bought in groups of 1-5.

Requires a Beastmaster in the warband. Ephemeral Creatures (never gain experience). If the Beastmaster dies or can't fight, the beasts vanish/don't participate. Esoteric Entity (always a 6+ armour save that can never be modified). Cause Fear. Use the Beastmaster's basic Leadership within 6" only. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Ephemeral Creatures
specialRules.description: Not of the physical plane; never gain experience.

specialRules.name: Esoteric Entity
specialRules.description: Always have a 6+ armour save that can never be modified in any way.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Tormentor Helm
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Counts as a helmet with a built-in Splinter Pistol (usable in addition to other weapons and in close combat, hitting on the user's BS). Causes Fear. Rare 9. (The special-gear table on p.084 lists it at 40 tn; p.086 lists 45 tn.)

exclusiveEquipment.name: Combat Drugs
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: One use, refilled after each use. On entering battle roll 2D6: 2 Bad Batch (taken OOA, no serious injury roll), 3-5 Resilient (+1 T), 6-8 Strong (+1 S), 9-11 Inured to Pain (count 1-4 as Knocked Down on the Injury chart), 12 Master Work (+1 WS/S/I/A) - for the battle.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Dark Venom
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: A dose of poison (see Master of Poisons).

exclusiveEquipment.name: Dark Eldar Blade
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Upgrade to a Dagger, Sword or Axe for +20 tn: Critical Damage (+1 to Critical Chart results), Wicked Edge (stuns on a 2-4), inherits the original weapon's positives and negatives. Rare 9.

specialRules: Dark Eldar Coterie. Kindred Hatred: Dark Eldar hate any and all other Eldar (Craftworld, Corsair or Exodite) warriors. Excellent Sight: can spot Hidden enemies from twice as far as normal warriors. Crudity of the Mon'Kiegh: if an Eldar uses any ranged weapon not on their warband's Equipment list it is at -2 Ballistic Skill. She who Thirsts: a Dark Eldar Coterie warband may never include any model that is a Psyker. | Min warband size 3, max 12. Warp Beasts require a Beastmaster. | Eldar have no sourced racial-maximum profile (ceilings left null).
